about: Golden cases for 'Decisions that know why' (services/agent_runtime_service/decision_why.py): decision_assumptions (the stated reasons a decision rests on), decision_ripple (goals and open tasks it moves) and assumption_check (which open assumptions new evidence clearly breaks). Hand-written. Transcript lines are 'S<n>: text'; speakers are numbered 'Participant N' in order of first speaking. keywords: every group must appear (lowercase) in the assumption's statement or quote; 'a|b' is either. Indices (goal, action, assumption) are 1-based. 'traps' are what a careless model would wrongly report: the deliberately worse prompts report them, the gate must not.
